battle.name: 科涅克同盟戰爭
battle.theater: 倫巴第、羅馬與那不勒斯
battle.brief: 一五二六年五月，法蘭索瓦一世、教宗、威尼斯、佛羅倫薩與斯福爾扎在科涅克城結盟，挑戰卡爾五世在義大利的霸權。聯軍先取洛迪，帝國軍則以六千名西班牙方陣兵為骨幹遠征羅馬；其後法軍東下那不勒斯，卻在蘭德里亞諾與加維納納被方陣的火繩槍齊射與騎兵反擊擊破，戰事以一五三〇年佛羅倫薩陷落收場。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法王法蘭索瓦一世領頭的科涅克同盟，與卡爾五世皇帝一方的聯盟。同盟在法國夏朗德省的科涅克城簽約，一五二六年五月二十二日，盟員是教宗克勉七世與教宗國、威尼斯共和國、佛羅倫薩共和國、米蘭的斯福爾扎家族，以及法蘭西王國本身；名義上的主持者是法王之妹瑪格麗特·德·奧芒，教廷一線則由教宗特任代表樞機波旁奔走。英格蘭的亨利八世本想入盟，但條約無法在英格蘭簽字，他因此退出。聯盟的軍隊是拼湊出來的：法國王室常備步兵與重騎、法國在役的瑞士傭兵、威尼斯與佛羅倫薩出錢的義大利傭兵、馬拉泰斯塔四世·巴廖尼率領的佩魯賈人馬，以及喬瓦尼·德·梅迪奇所領的黑帶營；作戰方式多為各路小部隊的零星出擊，並沒有統一的野戰指揮。對面是卡爾五世的聯盟：神聖羅馬帝國與西班牙王國的軍隊、駐在義大利半島的西班牙方陣、弗倫茨貝格率領的德意志傭兵、費蘭特·貢扎加指揮的帝國騎兵，以及教宗國、米蘭、費拉拉與曼圖雅這些先後轉向皇帝的邦國。帝國一方的野戰統帥是安東尼奧·德·萊瓦，攻城技術與海戰則分別落在佩德羅·納瓦羅與安德烈亞·多里亞手上。戰區之外，蘇萊曼的奧斯曼帝國隔地中海觀望，卡爾五世最終必須把注意力轉向東方，這決定了一五二九年之後整個戰局的走向。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the League of Cognac under King Francis I of France and the Habsburg coalition of Emperor Charles V. The league was concluded at Cognac in the Charente on 22 May 1526, its members being the Papal States under Pope Clement VII, the Republic of Venice, the Republic of Florence, the Sforza family of Milan and the Kingdom of France itself; nominally it was presided over by Margaret of Angoulême, the king's sister, while in Rome the papal legate a latere, Cardinal de Bourges, did the running. Henry VIII of England wanted to join but withdrew once the treaty could not be signed on English soil. The league's army was a patchwork: French royal foot and heavy cavalry, Swiss mercenaries in French pay, Italian condottieri paid for by Venice and Florence, the Perugian troops of Malatesta IV Baglioni, and the Black Bands of Giovanni de' Medici. Its fighting consisted of scattered local strikes by small detachments rather than any unified field command. Against it stood Charles V's coalition: the armies of the Holy Roman Empire and of Spain, the Spanish tercios quartered in the Italian peninsula, German Landsknechts under Georg von Frundsberg, imperial cavalry under Ferrante Gonzaga, and a string of Italian states — the Papal States, Milan, Ferrara and Mantua — that turned to the emperor one after another. On the imperial side the field command belonged to Antonio de Leyva, while siegecraft and naval warfare were in the hands of Pedro Navarro and Andrea Doria. Outside the theatre the Ottoman sultan Suleiman watched from across the Mediterranean, and the empire's need to turn east shaped everything that happened after 1529.
people: 全役的兩位主角是兩位君主。卡爾五世生於一五〇〇年，一五一六年登上西班牙王位，一五一九年當選神聖羅馬帝國皇帝，一五三〇年才在羅馬加冕；他靠一五二五年帕維亞的勝利和《馬德里條約》的鉗制取得上風，接著用幾年時間把義大利的聯盟逐個拆散。科涅克同盟的靈魂是法蘭索瓦一世本人：從一五二五年十月二十五日在帕維亞被俘，到一五二六年三月返國，他隨即宣布要援助教宗，五月二十二日即在科涅克簽約。法國一邊的主要人物有波旁公爵查理三世，他以法國騎兵總帥之號加入同盟，圍攻羅馬時在突擊中中彈，傷重而死，屍身被自己的德意志傭兵剝去甲冑與飾物；還有蒙莫朗西、旺多姆伯爵尚·德·波旁，以及聖波勒伯爵弗朗索瓦·德·波旁——他在蘭德里亞諾一役率援軍遭帝國軍擊潰並被俘。義大利方面有圭恰迪尼，以教宗國軍隊總指揮之身份在羅馬抵禦帝國軍而未能成軍；聯盟還僱來奧代·德·富瓦、佩德羅·納瓦羅（西班牙出身，後為法國效力，爵號奧利韋托伯爵）與烏爾比諾公爵弗朗切斯科·馬里亞·德拉·羅韋雷。帝國一邊有弗倫茨貝格（率一萬四千名德意志傭兵）、六千名西班牙方陣步兵的統帥、奧蘭治親王沙隆的菲利貝爾、帝國騎兵指揮費蘭特·貢扎加，以及那不勒斯方面的安東尼奧·德·萊瓦。海上最關鍵的變數是多里亞：這位熱那亞統帥先把艦隊交給法國，後來轉投皇帝，最後在熱那亞打破封鎖，迫使法軍在薩沃納投降。除此之外，還有在那不勒斯圍城中死於鼠疫的法軍、攻城時因欠餉而劫掠的德意志傭兵，以及整個帝國軍中站在火繩槍射線後面的射手；這場戰爭裡真正決定走向的，是那些排成方陣的人。
peopleEn: The two principals of this war were two monarchs. Charles V was born in 1500, ascended the Spanish throne in 1516, was elected Holy Roman Emperor in 1519 and was not crowned in Rome until 1530; he had the victory at Pavia in 1525 and the leverage of the Treaty of Madrid behind him, and he spent the following years taking the Italian alliance apart piece by piece. The soul of the League of Cognac was Francis I himself: from his capture at Pavia on 25 October 1525 to his return to France in March 1526 he announced he would aid the pope, and on 22 May he signed at Cognac. The leading Frenchmen of the league were Charles III, Duke of Bourbon, who entered the alliance as Constable of France and was struck by a cannon splinter during the assault on Rome, dying of his wounds, his body stripped of armour and valuables by his own Landsknechts; Anne de Montmorency; Jean, Count of Vendôme; and François de Bourbon, Count of Saint-Pol, who led the relief army beaten at Landriano and was taken prisoner. On the Italian side stood Francesco Guicciardini, commanding the papal army at Rome and unable to bring it into coherent order, while the league also employed Odet de Foix, Viscount of Lautrec, Pedro Navarro, Count of Oliveto — a Spaniard in French service — and Francesco Maria I della Rovere, Duke of Urbino. On the imperial side were Georg von Frundsberg with fourteen thousand German Landsknechts, the commanders of the six thousand Spanish tercios, Philibert of Châlon, Prince of Orange, Ferrante Gonzaga commanding the imperial cavalry, and Antonio de Leyva in the Neapolitan command. At sea the decisive variable was Andrea Doria: the Genoese admiral who first handed his fleet to France, then went over to the emperor, broke the blockade of Genoa and forced the French to surrender at Savona. Behind them stand the men who did the dying: the French army destroyed by plague before Naples, the unpaid Landsknechts who sacked Rome, and the thousands of men standing behind the matchlock; what really decided this war was the men who stood in square.
kits: 卡面這件是十六世紀初的西班牙火繩步槍，一五二〇年前後已定型：它靠火繩機構點火，操作分成上弦、裝藥、填棉、塞通條、點火五個步驟，射擊時把槍托架在叉形支架或長矛兵的矛柄上瞄準；受訓的射手每分鐘至多打出一發，雨天與大風裡火繩極易熄滅，鎗管又重，扛著它行軍和攀攻城頭都吃力。它在一五二六年的戰場上屬於西班牙方陣的骨幹：方陣把人分成長矛兵、火繩槍射手，以及專門攜帶火繩、火藥、彈藥包與棉花的勤務兵，十六世紀三〇年代成型的標準編制是一千五百名長矛兵、一千名火繩槍射手、三百名火繩與槍械勤務兵，合計約二千八百人；一五二六年的實際人數各來源說法不一，較保守的估計是一千五百至二千五百人。射手的打法是排成三排或四排，前排半跪，第二排瞄準，第三排裝填，聽號令分批齊射，靠前排的彈幕把敵方逼住，再由後排接手，形成連續的射擊節奏。史家為方陣點名時多以「火繩槍手」概稱，其中較重的火繩步槍在十六世紀二〇年代仍算新型號，多配於連長以上與骨幹射手，其後十年間才逐步取代輕手槍。戰役中火繩槍的位置很明確：一五二六年洗劫羅馬的帝國軍有六千名西班牙方陣步兵，火繩槍手是唯一能壓制城頭的可靠手段；一五二七年的那不勒斯圍城戰裡，圍城的法軍同樣靠火繩槍與火砲對付城牆與街壘；一五二九年蘭德里亞諾，法軍騎兵衝向帝國砲位時被方陣火繩槍的齊射打散；一五三〇年加維納納，佛羅倫薩的攻勢同樣死在帝國軍火繩槍手的線列射擊與騎兵反擊之下。此外戰役中還有長矛、輕火繩手槍、野戰砲與攻城臼砲、佩德羅·納瓦羅在米蘭與那不勒斯用過的地道爆破，以及海戰中安在戰艦上的火繩炮；騎兵配長柄騎槍與火繩手槍，並把火繩步槍自腰間皮套裡拔出射擊；後勤上最要命的是糧餉與彈藥，火繩用的硫磺與硝石、預先分裝的彈藥包、擦拭用的通條與棉花，都是行軍中體積龐大而重量可觀的負擔。
kitsEn: The card shows an early sixteenth-century Spanish matchlock musket, a type settled by about 1520: it is fired by a matchlock mechanism and worked in five stages — cocking, charging, plugging, pushing home the ramrod, and firing — and the shooter rested the stock either on a forked rest or on the shaft of a pikeman while aiming. A trained man could get off at best one shot a minute; in rain and high wind the match goes out easily, and the barrel is heavy, so the weapon is a burden on the march and in scaling a wall. In the field in 1526 it belonged to the backbone of the Spanish tercio: the tercio divided its men into pikemen, matchlock musketeers, and the servants who carried the matches, powder, cartridge packets and cotton, and the standard establishment that hardened in the 1530s was fifteen hundred pikemen, a thousand matchlock musketeers and three hundred match and piece servants, some twenty-eight hundred men in all. The numbers actually on the field in 1526 vary from source to source, the more conservative estimate being fifteen hundred to twenty-five hundred men. The musketeers fought in three or four ranks, the front rank half-kneeling, the second aiming, the third loading, and fired by command in successive volleys, the front rank's sheet of shot holding the enemy off while the rear ranks reloaded, and so a continuous rhythm of fire was kept up. When chroniclers counted a tercio they generally said 'arquebusiers', and the heavier matchlock musket was still a comparatively new piece in the twenties, issued mainly to sergeants and to the best shots, and only in the following decade did it begin to displace the lighter arquebus. Its place in this war is clear: the imperial army that sacked Rome in 1526 had six thousand Spanish tercios, and the musketeers were the only reliable means of silencing the walls; in the siege of Naples in 1527 the French besiegers likewise used matchlocks and heavy guns against the walls and the street barricades; at Landriano in 1529 French cavalry charging the imperial guns was broken by a volley from the tercios; and at Gavinana in 1530 the Florentine attack died in the same way, under the linear fire of the imperial matchlocks and the counter-stroke of the cavalry. The rest of the equipment in the campaign included pikes, the light matchlock arquebus, field and siege guns, the mining and blowing-up of walls used by Pedro Navarro before Milan and before Naples, and matchlocks fitted to warships for the sea fighting; the cavalry carried long lances and matchlock pistols, and drew the matchlock musket from its case at the saddle for a shot. On the logistics side, pay and ammunition were the real problem: the sulphur and nitre for the matches, the pre-packed cartridges, the ramrods and the cotton for cleaning were all bulky, weighty loads to be carried on the march.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術層面可以概括成一句話：聯盟有會戰的設想，帝國有會戰的準備，而聯盟輸在兩支大軍從未在同一時間、同一方向出現。第一階段，聯盟在一五二六年六月先取洛迪，一度進入米蘭，企圖靠法國兵與斯福爾扎家族的號召把倫巴第變成法國的勢力範圍；帝國的對應是弗倫茨貝格率一萬四千名德意志傭兵與六千名西班牙方陣兵在皮亞琴察集結，繞開聯盟正面，遠征教宗國。一五二七年五月，帝國軍進攻羅馬：攻城先以砲火壓制城牆與城樓，再以突擊隊攀城，方陣射手在梯隊後方成排齊射，壓制守軍的反擊；教宗國的圭恰迪尼未能組織有效的防禦，帝國軍破城之後洗劫全城。第三階段是一五二七至一五二八年的法國反攻，奧代·德·富瓦與佩德羅·納瓦羅率法軍經熱那亞南下，企圖在王國那不勒斯撬起反攻，卻被多里亞的叛變與營中鼠疫摧毀。海上，多里亞在熱那亞解開封鎖，聯盟艦隊在薩沃納被迫投降；一五二八年八月那不勒斯灣海戰，帝國海軍在菲利波·多里亞率領下以火砲與火繩槍的近距離齊射擊潰聯盟船隊。第四階段是決定性的一五二九年：聖波勒伯爵率領的法國援軍在蘭德里亞諾被帝國軍擊潰，法軍騎兵衝向帝國砲位時被西班牙方陣的射手齊射擊落，帝國騎兵再從側翼反擊。隨後佛羅倫薩獨力抵抗，帝國軍在沙隆的菲利貝爾指揮下，於一五三〇年八月在加維納納用線列火繩槍射擊與騎兵迂迴擊破佛羅倫薩軍，圍城十日後城市投降。整體看，十六世紀二〇年代的戰術正在從單兵決鬥轉向線列齊射與大隊密度：方陣前進靠長矛遮蔽，火繩槍手躲在矛叢後面分批射擊，砲隊在側翼展開，騎兵退到己方火力的掩護之下才敢衝鋒，後勤線則決定了攻城與遠征究竟能撐多久。
tacticsEn: The tactical story of this war can be put in one sentence: the league had plans for a pitched battle, the empire had prepared for one, and the league lost because its two great armies never appeared at the same time in the same direction. In the first phase the league took Lodi in June 1526 and entered Milan, hoping that French troops and the Sforza banners would turn Lombardy into a French sphere; the imperial answer was Georg von Frundsberg's fourteen thousand Landsknechts and six thousand Spanish tercios, assembled at Piacenza, marching past the league's front to make a long march into the Papal States. In May 1527 the imperial army attacked Rome: artillery first crushed the walls and towers, assault parties then scaled them, the tercios' musketeers firing in ranked volleys behind the escalade teams to smother the defenders' counter-attacks; Guicciardini could not bring the papal army into any coherent defence, and after the breach the imperial troops sacked the city. The third phase was the French counter-offensive of 1527 and 1528, when Odet de Foix and Pedro Navarro led a French army down through Genoa to raise the Kingdom of Naples; it was destroyed instead by Doria's defection and by plague in the camp. At sea Doria broke the blockade of Genoa and the league's squadron was forced to surrender at Savona; in the battle in the Gulf of Naples in August 1528 the imperial fleet under Filippino Doria broke the league's ships with gunfire and massed matchlock fire at close range. The fourth phase was the decisive year of 1529: at Landriano the French relief army under the Count of Saint-Pol was broken by the imperial force, the French cavalry falling back from the imperial guns under a volley from the Spanish tercios, and the imperial cavalry then counter-charging on the flank. Florence then resisted alone; under Philibert of Châlon the imperial army beat the Florentine army at Gavinana in August 1530 with linear matchlock fire and a cavalry flanking movement, and the city surrendered ten days later. Taken as a whole, the tactics of the 1520s were turning from single combat towards linear volley fire and massed density: the tercio advanced behind the shelter of its pikes, the musketeers fired in successive volleys from behind the hedge of spears, the guns deployed on the flanks, and the cavalry only charged under cover of its own foot, while the length of the supply line decided how long a siege or an expedition could be held.
data: 可考的數字集中在幾個節點上。一五二六年五月二十二日，聯盟在科涅克城簽約；同年六月聯盟軍佔領洛迪，帝國軍隨後進軍倫巴第，迫使斯福爾扎家族放棄米蘭；九月科隆納家族一度攻入羅馬，擊敗教宗軍隊並短暫控制市內，數日後付清代價撤走。帝國方面的核心數字是：一萬四千名德意志傭兵與六千名西班牙方陣步兵，在皮亞琴察集結後向羅馬進軍；一五二七年五月攻陷並洗劫羅馬，教宗近衛的瑞士營以不到三千人的兵力殿後，護送教宗退入聖安杰洛堡。一五二七年四月三十日，英法簽訂韋斯敏斯特條約。一五二七至一五二八年，法國遠征軍在熱那亞與那不勒斯之間拉開，營地鼠疫流行，統帥奧代·德·富瓦與佩德羅·納瓦羅皆死於疫病，法軍主力幾乎全軍覆沒；同年八月帝國海軍在那不勒斯灣擊潰聯盟船隊。一五二九年三月至五月，威尼斯主導的莫諾波利圍城戰重奪阿普利亞的港口，但莫諾波利在數月後仍向西班牙人投降；同年六月二十一日的蘭德里亞諾戰役，帝國軍在安東尼奧·德·萊瓦指揮下擊潰法國援軍，法國在義大利的野戰骨幹就此終結；同年七月在康布雷開始和談，八月三日《康布雷條約》簽訂，條款基本重複《馬德里條約》：法國放棄阿圖瓦、佛蘭德斯與圖爾奈，支付二百萬金埃居贖金以換取人質獲釋，勃艮第讓步與波旁相關條款則被刪去；威尼斯交出拉文納、切爾維亞與阿普利亞殘餘屬地，換取保留馬里尼亞諾的戰果；弗朗切斯科·斯福爾扎以九十萬斯庫迪的代價重返米蘭。一五三〇年八月加維納納，帝國軍取勝，佛羅倫薩共和國在十日後投降，亞歷山德羅·德·梅迪奇受冊為公爵，一五三二年佛羅倫薩的共和制正式終結。火器方面，受訓的火繩槍射手每分鐘至多一發；方陣的標準編制約二千八百人，一五二六年的實際人數說法不一。傷亡方面，羅馬洗劫時的掠奪數字與兩軍陣亡數在當時編年史中多有誇大且互相矛盾，本條目只採有明確出處者；可以確定的是，那不勒斯遠征的崩潰主因是疫病而非會戰，而蘭德里亞諾與加維納納兩役的敗方，都是在一天之內整支部隊垮掉的。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on cluster around a few fixed points. On 22 May 1526 the league was concluded at Cognac; in June of that year the league's troops occupied Lodi, imperial troops then marched into Lombardy and the Sforza were forced to abandon Milan; in September the Colonna family attacked Rome, defeated the papal forces, briefly held the city, and left after payment was made. The central imperial numbers are these: fourteen thousand German Landsknechts and six thousand Spanish tercios, assembled at Piacenza and then marched on Rome; in May 1527 the city was taken and sacked, and the Swiss companies of the papal guard, fewer than three thousand men, covered the retreat and carried the pope into Castel Sant'Angelo. On 30 April 1527 England and France signed the Treaty of Westminster. In 1527 and 1528 the French expedition was strung out between Genoa and Naples, plague broke out in the camp, both Odet de Foix and Pedro Navarro died of the sickness, and the French field army was virtually wiped out; in the same year, in August, the imperial fleet destroyed the league's squadron in the Gulf of Naples. From March to May 1529 the Venetian-led siege of Monopoli retook the Apulian ports, though Monopoli itself was surrendered to the Spaniards a few months later; on 21 June 1529 the battle of Landriano was won by the imperial army under Antonio de Leyva, and the French lost the last of their field force in Italy; negotiations opened at Cambrai in July, and on 3 August the Treaty of Cambrai was signed on terms that largely repeated the Treaty of Madrid: France gave up Artois, Flanders and Tournai and was to pay a ransom of two million golden écus for the release of the hostages, while the cession of Burgundy and the clauses concerning Charles de Bourbon were dropped; Venice surrendered Ravenna, Cervia and her remaining Apulian possessions in exchange for being allowed to keep what she had won at Marignano; and Francesco Sforza was allowed back into Milan for the price of nine hundred thousand scudi. In August 1530 Gavinana was won by the imperial side, the Florentine Republic surrendered ten days later, Alessandro de' Medici was installed as duke, and in 1532 the republican form of Florence was formally ended. On firearms, a trained matchlock musketeer could fire at most one shot a minute; the standard tercio establishment was some twenty-eight hundred men, while the numbers actually present in 1526 differ from source to source. On losses, the figures for the plunder of Rome and for the killed on both sides are inflated and contradictory in the chronicles of the time, and only those with a clear source have been used here; what can be established is that the collapse before Naples was caused by plague rather than by any pitched battle, while at Landriano and at Gavinana whole formations went down in the course of a single day.
cause: 起因是帕維亞之後的舊賬，加上一五二六年的聯盟外交。一五二五年十月二十五日，法蘭索瓦一世在帕維亞被卡爾五世的帝國軍與西班牙軍生擒，法軍幾乎全滅；一五二六年一月三十日簽訂的《馬德里條約》要求他放棄勃艮第、讓出義大利的權位，並以兩個兒子作人質。法蘭索瓦於同年三月返回法國，國力與信用都跌到谷底，但他拒絕承認帝國在義大利的霸權：一方面米蘭是法國在倫巴第僅剩的立足點，失去米蘭等於把義大利拱手讓人；另一方面卡爾五世手上的西班牙銀流與帝國的軍事優勢已形成包圍法國的格局，法國若不在義大利反擊，哈布斯堡的壓力只會從東面逼近法國本土。就在這個時候，教宗克勉七世與威尼斯都感到帝國在意大利的擴張難以忍受：克勉七世面對的是皇帝在帝國境內的兵權遠超教宗能對抗的程度，而威尼斯擔心帝國的勢力一旦在義大利站穩，其在亞得里亞海的航路與鹽利就要受制於人。於是一五二六年五月二十二日，教宗、法國、威尼斯、佛羅倫薩與斯福爾扎家族在科涅克城簽下同一份盟約，由法王之妹瑪格麗特·德·奧芒掛名主持，教宗特任代表樞機波旁在教廷奔走。亨利八世想加入，但條約無法在英格蘭簽下，他因此退出。卡爾五世視此為對帝國權威的公開挑戰：一五二六年秋他已備妥入侵計劃，把戰爭的地理範圍從倫巴第一路推到教宗國；一五二七年洗劫羅馬之後，教宗國的自主實質上喪失，聯盟轉而尋求海上與那不勒斯方面的替代方案，把一場本該速戰速決的戰爭拖成四年消耗，而這正是聯盟最不擅長的形態。
causeEn: The cause lay in the old score left over from Pavia and in the diplomacy of the league in 1526. On 25 October 1525 Francis I was taken prisoner at Pavia by the imperial and Spanish forces of Charles V and the French army was practically annihilated; the Treaty of Madrid of 30 January 1526 required him to renounce Burgundy, to give up his position in Italy, and to leave his two sons as hostages. Francis returned to France in March of that year, with the treasury and the credit of the monarchy at their lowest, but he refused to accept the empire's hegemony in Italy: Milan was France's last foothold in Lombardy, and losing it would hand Italy over; and the Spanish silver and the imperial armies under Charles V already formed a ring closing around France, so that if France did not counterattack in Italy the Habsburg pressure would only close in on French soil from the east. At the same moment Pope Clement VII and Venice found the imperial expansion intolerable: Clement faced an emperor whose armed strength inside the empire was far beyond anything the papacy could match, and Venice feared that once the imperial position was secure in Italy her sea lanes and salt trade in the Adriatic would be at the mercy of others. And so on 22 May 1526 the pope, France, Venice, Florence and the Sforza signed one instrument at Cognac, nominally presided over by Margaret of Angoulême, the king's sister, with the papal legate Cardinal de Bourges working in Rome. Henry VIII wanted in, but the treaty could not be signed in England, and he withdrew. Charles V read the league as a public challenge to imperial authority: by the autumn of 1526 he already had his invasion prepared, and he carried the war out of Lombardy and deep into the Papal States; after the sack of Rome in 1527 the effective independence of the Papal States was gone, and the league turned to the sea and to Naples for an alternative, stretching a war that should have been decided quickly into four years of attrition — the one form of warfare the league was worst at.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果對歐洲格局有幾層長遠的影響。第一，義大利的棋盤被重排：一五三〇年佛羅倫薩共和國覆亡，亞歷山德羅·德·梅迪奇在一五三二年被教宗立為公爵，佛羅倫薩由數百年的共和政體改為美第奇家族的世襲君主國；威尼斯交出拉文納、切爾維亞與阿普利亞的殘餘屬地後退守本土；米蘭回到弗朗切斯科·斯福爾扎手中，但要以九十萬斯庫迪為代價，而且是在帝國的實際保護之下。義大利此後數十年成為西班牙的勢力範圍，帝國的稅源與西班牙的白銀從此可以沿著同一條道路輸送。第二，完成了法國在義大利的戰略退卻，同時確立了一種談判方式：一五二九年在康布雷，法蘭索瓦的母親薩伏依的路易絲代表法國，皇帝姑母奧地利的瑪格麗特代表帝國，兩位女性主持了條約的談判，這種形式被後人稱為女士和約，成為此後歐洲外交的一個特例。第三，教宗國的地位被徹底改變：一五二七年羅馬陷落、教宗退入聖安杰洛堡，直到一五三〇年二月教宗在博洛尼亞為皇帝加冕，教廷此後數十年不敢與皇帝正面衝突；教宗出逃聖安杰洛堡這件事更成為教廷沿用的徽記與口號的一部分，一直用到一八七〇年。第四，軍事的影響最為直接：這場戰爭是西班牙方陣作為獨立建制的成形期，六千名西班牙方陣步兵在洗劫羅馬的戰役中展示了長矛與火繩槍混編的密度優勢，一五二九年蘭德里亞諾與一五三〇年加維納納兩役，帝國軍一次又一次用方陣的線列齊射與騎兵反擊，擊敗數量相當的法國與佛羅倫薩步兵；方陣此後成為西班牙往後百餘年海外擴張的基本工具，把西班牙之路從一支隊伍變成一套體系。第五，這場戰爭改變了西地中海的走向：卡爾五世在義大利的戰事拖到一五二九年才結束，使他無暇兼顧地中海，一五三〇年才得以率軍遠征突尼斯，帝國的資源此後大規模轉向對付奧斯曼，地中海的均勢因此被打破。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reshaped Europe in several durable ways. First, the Italian board was rearranged: in 1530 the Florentine Republic fell, Alessandro de' Medici was installed as duke by the pope in 1532, and Florence passed from a republican government of several centuries to a hereditary monarchy of the Medici; Venice, having surrendered Ravenna, Cervia and her remaining Apulian possessions, fell back onto her own territory; and Milan returned to Francesco Sforza, but at the price of nine hundred thousand scudi and under the practical protection of the empire. Italy lay for decades afterwards inside the Spanish sphere, and imperial revenue and Spanish silver could thereafter travel the same road. Second, France made its strategic retreat from Italy, and in the process a mode of negotiation was established: at Cambrai in 1529 Louise of Savoy spoke for France and Margaret of Austria, the emperor's aunt, for the empire, and the two women conducted the talks, a form afterwards called the Peace of the Ladies and long remembered as a peculiarity of European diplomacy. Third, the position of the papacy was transformed: with Rome in ruins in 1527 and the pope shut up in Castel Sant'Angelo, and only crowning the emperor at Bologna in February 1530, the papacy did not dare stand in front of the emperor again for decades; the flight to the Castel Sant'Angelo even became part of the papal arms and motto, and remained so until 1870. Fourth, the military effect is the most direct of all: this war was the period in which the Spanish tercio hardened into an independent institution, the six thousand Spanish tercios showed at the sack of Rome the density advantage of pikes and matchlocks mixed in one formation, and at Landriano in 1529 and Gavinana in 1530 the imperial army beat French and Florentine infantry of comparable numbers twice over with linear volley fire and cavalry counter-strikes; the tercio then became the basic instrument of Spanish expansion for the next hundred years, turning the Spanish road from a mere army into a system. Fifth, the war changed the balance of the western Mediterranean: Charles V's Italian war dragged on until 1529, which kept him from giving his attention to the Mediterranean until he could cross to Tunis in 1530, and the empire's resources were thereafter thrown wholesale against the Ottomans, breaking the Mediterranean equilibrium.
result: 一五二六年五月聯盟成立，先取洛迪；同年九月科隆納家族一度攻入羅馬。帝國的答覆是弗倫茨貝格與波旁公爵查理三世率一萬四千名德意志傭兵和六千名西班牙方陣兵在皮亞琴察集結，於一五二七年五月攻陷羅馬、洗劫全城，教宗退守聖安杰洛堡，帝國隨後在博洛尼亞接納教宗並為他加冕。教廷的屈服令聯盟失去最重要的盟員與最重要的依託。聯盟再作反擊：一五二七年四月三十日英法簽訂韋斯敏斯特條約，亨利八世入盟；法軍在奧代·德·富瓦與佩德羅·納瓦羅率領下經熱那亞南下，包圍那不勒斯城，但多里亞改旗易幟、營中鼠疫肆行，統帥與大軍同葬疫中，海上聯盟船隊也在那一年覆沒。帝國隨即收緊：多里亞在熱那亞打破封鎖，迫使法軍在薩沃納投降；一五二九年三月至五月威尼斯主導的莫諾波利圍城戰雖一度收復阿普利亞的港口，但莫諾波利在數月後仍歸西班牙人；一五二九年六月二十一日的蘭德里亞諾戰役，帝國軍在安東尼奧·德·萊瓦指揮下擊潰法國援軍，法國失去在義大利的野戰骨幹。聯盟只剩下威尼斯、佛羅倫薩與教宗。一五二九年七月起在康布雷進行和談，薩伏依的路易絲與奧地利的瑪格麗特主持談判；八月三日《康布雷條約》簽訂，法國退出戰爭，放棄阿圖瓦、佛蘭德斯與圖爾奈，支付二百萬金埃居贖金換取兒子人質獲釋，勃艮第與波旁的條款被刪去；威尼斯交出拉文納、切爾維亞與阿普利亞殘餘屬地；弗朗切斯科·斯福爾扎以九十萬斯庫迪重返米蘭。戰爭的最後一段是佛羅倫薩一城的抵抗：帝國軍在奧蘭治親王沙隆的菲利貝爾指揮下，於一五三〇年八月在加維納納以火繩槍的線列射擊與騎兵迂迴擊敗費魯喬的佛羅倫薩軍，親王陣亡，城市在十日後投降，亞歷山德羅·德·梅迪奇受冊為公爵。結果是清楚的：哈布斯堡取勝，法國退出義大利，佛羅倫薩的共和時代結束，帝國在義大利的霸權確立；而這場戰爭留下的火器運用與編制經驗，也在隨後數十年裡隨西班牙的旗幟走遍歐洲。
resultEn: In May 1526 the league was founded and took Lodi; in September of the same year the Colonna family briefly entered Rome. The imperial reply was Frundsberg and Charles III, Duke of Bourbon, leading fourteen thousand German Landsknechts and six thousand Spanish tercios, assembled at Piacenza, into Rome in May 1527, which was taken and sacked, the pope retiring to Castel Sant'Angelo, the empire afterwards receiving the pope at Bologna and crowning him. The submission of the papacy cost the league its most important member and its main support. The league tried again: on 30 April 1527 England and France signed the Treaty of Westminster and Henry VIII came in; and under Odet de Foix and Pedro Navarro the French marched down through Genoa and invested the city of Naples, but Doria changed sides, plague ran through the camp, commander and army were buried with the sickness, and the league's fleet was lost at sea in the same year. The empire then tightened: Doria broke the blockade of Genoa and forced the French to surrender at Savona; between March and May 1529 the Venetian-led siege of Monopoli recovered the Apulian ports for a time, though Monopoli itself passed to the Spaniards a few months later; and on 21 June 1529 the battle of Landriano was won by the imperial army under Antonio de Leyva, and France lost the last of its field force in Italy. Only Venice, Florence and the pope were left. Negotiations opened at Cambrai in July 1529, conducted by Louise of Savoy and Margaret of Austria; on 3 August the Treaty of Cambrai was signed, France left the war, renounced Artois, Flanders and Tournai, and agreed a ransom of two million golden écus for the release of her sons, while the clauses on Burgundy and on Bourbon were dropped; Venice surrendered Ravenna, Cervia and her remaining Apulian possessions; and Francesco Sforza returned to Milan for nine hundred thousand scudi. The last stage of the war was the resistance of a single city, Florence: under Philibert of Châlon, Prince of Orange, the imperial army beat Francesco Ferruccio's Florentine force at Gavinana in August 1530 with linear matchlock fire and a cavalry flanking movement; the prince was killed, the city surrendered ten days later, and Alessandro de' Medici was installed as duke. The result is plain: the Habsburgs won, France left Italy, the republican age of Florence ended, and imperial primacy in Italy was established; and the firing drill and formations worked out in this war travelled across Europe with the Spanish banners for decades afterwards.
